rappel_detail.anchor: existing sling or webbing around a rock horn, not bolted; inspect it
rappel_detail.station: On the Class 3-4 rock near the summit ridge.
rappel_detail.notes: Optional short single-rope rappel that some parties use; the descent is otherwise a downclimb.

set.rappels: 1 optional short single-rope rappel from a slung horn near the summit ridge; otherwise a downclimb
set.descent: Downclimb the east ridge to the Northeast Gully, descend the gully to the Colonial-Snowfield col, and recross the Colonial Glacier to the Pyramid Ridge camp.
